description: Replacement of existing externally illuminated fascia signage with internally illuminated signage comprising 1 no. illuminated letterset and 1 no. illuminated golden underscore, together with the relocation and redecoration of the existing projecting sign.
decision_conditions: The proposed fascia sign, by reason of its internal illumination and visual prominence, would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Enfield Town Conservation Area and would detract from the architectural significance of the host building, which is identified as making a positive contribution to the Conservation Area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990. The harm caused is not outweighed by any identified public benefits and therefore fails to accord with Section 12 and Section 16 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026); Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021); Policies 37, 40, 41 and 44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014); Policies 30 and 31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010); and Enfield Shopfronts and Associated Advertisements Supplementary Planning Guidance.
